winner.victorySpeech: My fellow Valorians, after a hard-fought campaign, your steady hand prevails. To my opponents—those passionate, untested voices—I extend partnership, not scorn. Today, by executive decree, I ban all foreign-controlled algorithmic applications, protecting our children's minds and Valoria's precious data. Tested leadership delivers. Steady Valoria endures.
